scope: Three checkpoints from one synthetic compute transaction scenario.

acceptance.infrastructure_failure: Harbor exception, Modal or provider failure, failed artifact collection, missing verifier output, or any nested judge error. Retain and report, but exclude from performance estimates.
acceptance.agent_invalid_output: A missing or malformed required DOCX after otherwise normal agent execution. Include as semantic score 0 and all_pass 0.
acceptance.accepted_trial: Normal execution, exact required artifact collected with status ok, completed RewardKit grading, and no nested judge error.

reporting.primary: Per-task semantic criterion pass rate, excluding output integrity.
secondary: separate visual review of every DOCX
limitations: Five attempts estimate rollout variability, not scenario variability.
The three tasks are checkpoints from one scenario and are not independent matters.
The result does not establish broad compute-market generalization or a model ranking.
